messages:
elaine: Noticed jittery p95/p99 on us-west2-rack18 starting ~08:45 UTC. Heatmaps show repeated thermal oscillation on GPUs -> fans ramp up/down every ~6m. Looks correlated with a single tenant that keeps re-warming KV caches.
raj: Graf link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/thermal?panelId=9 :heat_wave:
noah: infra-bot flagged PCIe pcie_tx_retries rising on the same nodes. Could be IO storm + powercap hysteresis.
infra-bot: ALERT: rack/us-west2-rack18 - metrics: gpu_temp_variance_high, pcie_tx_retries_inc. Triggered 1746005400.
elaine: Hypothesis: tenant-heavy micro-batches -> sustained mem traffic -> PCIe replays -> increased GPU fan + powercap-> downclock -> KV cache spill -> prefill loops restart -> repeat.
sam: If it's PCIe-related, moving slices won't fully fix it. We can try a soft-quarantine (no evict) + apply per-tenant IO throttle and reduce their prefill concurrency.
ops_lead: We want minimal customer impact. Apply soft-quarantine label and throttle first. Who owns the tenant?
lena: It's team-horizon (contacted). They're running nightly regen for embeddings, didn't realize concurrency ramped. They've acknowledged.
raj: Mitigation plan (quick):
1) soft-quarantine tenant-horizon via scheduler tag (no co-locate with low-latency slices)
2) apply per-tenant IO cap: nic/egress and pci_tx_limit using eBPF policer
3) lower powercap on affected hosts to keep thermal stable (avoid oscillation)
4) reduce warm-pool prefill concurrency region-wide to 6 for 1 hour
noah: I can push the eBPF policer and scheduler tag. Command to tag:
```bash
# tag tenant
infractl tenant tag tenant-horizon noisy:soft-quarantine --reason "pcie_oscillation"
# apply eBPF policer
infractl net apply-policer --tenant tenant-horizon --rate 150Mbps --burst 8KB
```
elaine: I'll coordinate host-level powercap tweak (temporary -10W) on rack18 nodes to smooth fan curve. Sam, can you add a hysteresis rule to avoid repeated power-down cycles?
sam: Adding hysteresis: will adjust thermal-controller to require 3 consecutive high-temp intervals before downclock and extend cooldown hold to 8 minutes.
infra-bot: ACTION CREATED: ticket INF-4622 - pci-thermal-oscillation soft-quarantine + eBPF policer applied. Owner: noah.
lena: Team-horizon paused their regen. They asked about performance guidance: can we give recommended prefill taper and pci-friendly batch sizes?
raj: Quick guidance: prefer larger batches but with internal pacing; avoid sub-50ms GPU bursts that thrash PCIe. Also set tenant prefill concurrency <= 6. We'll put details in a short doc.
noah: Canary changes deployed to rack18. Observability: enabling PCIe txn retries panel and per-tenant IO throttles.
elaine: Early signals good: p99 dropped from 1.6s -> 520ms and pcie_tx_retries went down. Fans stabilized.
ops_lead: Note on routing: can't push tenant to apac due to quotas, eu fallback available but increases egress spend. Approve cross-region routing only if SLO risk persists.
raj: Follow-ups: 1) run a three-hour soak, 2) add scheduler-level per-tenant IO caps as a feature request, 3) document batch-size guidance for embeddings/regen workload.
sam: I'll open a small RFC for thermal-hysteresis + scheduler cap feature.
ops_lead: Good work. Keep INF-4622 updated and prepare a short postmortem if oscillation recurs. :thumbsup:
